_comment: What the toolkit posts to /typo3/record/edit for an element with a flexform column. A flexform field has no single input: the form posts one per value, named down the path to it. The npm side asserts create() produces exactly this; the extension feeds it to a real DataHandler and asserts the value reaches the stored XML. The NEW identifier is minted per request, so it is named here for a reader and renamed in the posted body before comparing. The value is padded on purpose: a name the data structure does not know is stored unchanged, so only a trimmed value proves the sheet and the field were found.
